svg.title: Proposed certification chain for a Bell target
svg.desc: An attained quantum score supplies a lower bound on the quantum support, and an SDP certificate supplies an upper bound. Genuine multipartite entanglement instead follows when the attained score exceeds a separately certified actual biseparable support bound. Apply only the symmetry of the chosen target and constraints.

g.text: A resource gap needs a separate bound for every bipartition
